bad_cell: BatteryPackConfig!B4 holds datetime.datetime(2020, 1, 1, 0, 0), a date/time value. The cell's number format is a date format, so its cached value is a time serial rather than a number. In Excel the underlying arithmetic is still correct; every Python reader of this file sees a datetime. Set the cell's format to General. Do NOT coerce this to a float — the coercion is the bug.
fuse_only: none of ('series battery count',) found among the labels on 'BatteryPackConfig'
no_par: none of ('parrallel battery count', 'parallel battery count') found among the labels on 'BatteryPackConfig'
series_alone: none of ('parrallel battery count', 'parallel battery count') found among the labels on 'BatteryPackConfig'
series_only: none of ('fuse max',) found among the labels on 'BatteryPackConfig'
unlabelled: no sheet contains the pack topology labels. Note that the shipped readers look for a sheet *named* 'Battery Pack Calcs' and this file's is 'BatteryPackConfig', which is exactly why they fail silently — searching by label avoids that whole class of bug.
